subtasks.title: Add OrgScanPathPositionsQuery — batched org-wide last-scan-point reader
subtasks.approach: New ClickhouseQuery subclass that answers "where was each of these kits last seen scanning?" in ONE round trip, so driverPositions() can degrade the same way its sibling already does (ClarityScoutMapController.php:543-569 is the single-kit version this batches). kit_scan_paths is ORDER BY (org_id, kit_id, timestamp) and carries NO kit_mapping column, so this needs its own kit_id-keyed reader rather than a variant of OrgLivePositionsQuery (which is keyed by lower(kit_mapping)). Batched, not fanned out per kit: the endpoint is polled ~10s for a whole org (Premier: 178 kits). Model the class on OrgLivePositionsQuery.php:20-78 (same argMax-per-group shape, same defaultCutoff()/UTC discipline, same `AS ts` alias convention) and on KitScanPathsQuery.php:76 for the mandatory FINAL. TDD: write tests/Unit/Clickhouse/Queries/OrgScanPathPositionsQueryTest.php first (it fails on a missing class), then the class. The test class needs `use Tests\Concerns\RequiresClickhouse` — that trait SKIPS THE WHOLE CLASS unless CLICKHOUSE_DRIVER=clickhouse, so a green run may mean "skipped": confirm from the runner output that the tests actually EXECUTED, not that the class was skipped. clarity.kit_scan_paths has a 90-day DELETE TTL applied AT INSERT, so every fixture timestamp must be anchored to now()/now()->subMinutes(N) — a hardcoded past date reads back 0 rows with nothing to blame.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
NEW app/Clickhouse/Queries/OrgScanPathPositionsQuery.php:
  namespace App\Clickhouse\Queries; final-ish `class OrgScanPathPositionsQuery extends ClickhouseQuery`,
  `declare(strict_types=1)`, docblock explaining it is the tier-2 org-wide analogue of kitPosition()'s
  kit_scan_paths read and WHY it is keyed by kit_id and not kit_mapping.

  public static function handle(array $arguments = []): array
    $orgId  = (int) ($arguments['org_id'] ?? 0);
    $kitIds = array_values(array_unique(array_map('intval', $arguments['kit_ids'] ?? [])));
    if ($orgId === 0 || $kitIds === []) { return []; }   // short-circuit: no round trip
    $cutoff = (string) ($arguments['cutoff'] ?? self::defaultCutoff());

    $rows = DB::clickhouse('kit_scan_paths', final: true)
      ->select(['kit_id'])
      // Two SCALAR argMax columns, NOT argMax() over the tuple: this avoids the
      // driver-dependent tuple decoding kitPosition() has to hand-destructure
      // ([$lng,$lat] = $lastPoint at ClarityScoutMapController.php:557).
      ->selectRaw('argMax(tupleElement(arrayElement(path_points, length(path_points)), 1), timestamp) AS lng')
      ->selectRaw('argMax(tupleElement(arrayElement(path_points, length(path_points)), 2), timestamp) AS lat')
      ->selectRaw('toString(max(timestamp)) AS ts')   // `ts`, not `timestamp_utc` — alias-shadowing convention
      ->where('org_id', $orgId)
      ->whereIntegerInRaw('kit_id', $kitIds)
      ->where('timestamp', '>=', $cutoff)
      // Empty bucket guard: arrayElement() on an empty array returns the DEFAULT
      // tuple (0,0), which would plot a phantom dot in the Atlantic. This is NOT
      // the dropped (0,0) sentinel work on sc_positions — it is an out-of-bounds guard.
      ->whereRaw('length(path_points) >= 1')
      ->groupBy('kit_id')
      ->get();

    return array_map(static fn ($row) => [
      'kit_id' => (int) ($row['kit_id'] ?? $row->kit_id),
      'lng' => (float) ($row['lng'] ?? $row->lng),
      'lat' => (float) ($row['lat'] ?? $row->lat),
      'timestamp_utc' => (string) ($row['ts'] ?? $row->ts),   // key name matches OrgLivePositionsQuery's contract
    ], $rows->toArray());

  protected static function defaultCutoff(): string  =>  now()->utc()->subHours(24)->toDateTimeString();
  (copy OrgLivePositionsQuery::defaultCutoff() verbatim + its DEV-2164 UTC comment)

  Return-shape docblock: @return list<array{kit_id: int, lng: float, lat: float, timestamp_utc: string}>

subtasks.title: Merge the kit_scan_paths fallback tier into driverPositions() and add position_source
subtasks.approach: THE FIX. ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController::driverPositions() (:78-129) is single-source on clarity.sc_positions and silently drops any kit with no row, while the sibling ClarityScoutMapController::kitPosition() (:473-608) already degrades to clarity.kit_scan_paths for exactly this case — its comment at :489 says the fallback exists "for kits not reporting to sc_positions". Production measurement (derivation-log d4) shows 6/6 currently-affected kits at Premier Adjusters / Accurate are renderable from kit_scan_paths inside the endpoint's own 24h window, with 0 unrescuable. Three edits land together in this one file because they are inseparable: (a) the tier-2 merge, (b) sourcing the "missing" set from the FULL scoped Kit collection instead of $byMapping's keys, so kits that kitsByMapping() (:742-757) drops for a null/empty kit_mapping are ALSO rescued via kit_id, and (c) the new `position_source` provenance key (Q3). The two join keys must not be conflated: sc_positions is keyed by lower(kit_mapping), kit_scan_paths by (org_id, kit_id). Repo convention holds throughout — log + return a degraded payload on any ClickHouse Throwable, never a 500. Do NOT add a tier-3 kit_trips fallback (0 measured rescues; kit_trips derives from sc_positions so it is empty exactly when sc_positions is) and do NOT touch the inert (0,0) discard at :108. TDD: add the six ClarityScoutBirdsEyeControllerTest cases first — the tier-1 happy-path pin passes immediately (regression guard for an endpoint with ZERO existing coverage), the fallback/mapping-less/one-query cases go RED — then implement. The test class already `use RequiresClickhouse`, which SKIPS THE WHOLE CLASS unless CLICKHOUSE_DRIVER=clickhouse: confirm from the runner output that these tests EXECUTED rather than skipped, or the RED->GREEN transition proves nothing. Anchor every kit_scan_paths fixture to now() (90-day insert-time DELETE TTL) — the file's own frozenNow() helper at :102 documents why.

subtasks.title: Key the DEV-2197 no-GPS banner on a real-GPS dot count
subtasks.approach: Q2 (Dalton): this is the one genuine regression the fix itself introduces. DEV-2197's "No kits are reporting GPS locations" notice fires on (driverPositions?.length ?? 0) === 0 (App.vue:339-345). Once t2 ships, a fully GPS-dark org with active scan coverage gets a rescued dot for every driver, that condition goes false, and a statement that is still TRUE is silently suppressed. Re-key the condition on a count of entries whose position_source === 'gps' so the banner keeps firing for exactly the fully-dark orgs it was built for. Both consumers of noKitsReporting (the dismissible centered card at App.vue:38 and the persistent amber pill at App.vue:90) inherit the fix from the single computed — do not duplicate the predicate. Depends on t2 for the field NAME; the store passes the payload through verbatim (stores/map.js:943 `driverPositions.value = (await response.json()).data ?? []`), so no store change is needed. Be tolerant of a missing key (older cached payloads, and the driver PWA which never sets it) — treat absent as NOT gps only after confirming the guard cannot make the banner fire on the driver surface: the computed is already gated on mapStore.adminMode. No JS test runner exists in this repo, so the test_filter is the PHP payload-contract test from t2 rather than a real guard for this file; the actual verification is human QA on the Bird's Eye map (flagged in the QA guide).

subtasks.title: Dim the scan-derived driver dot and label it in its tooltip
subtasks.approach: Q1 (Dalton, cosmetic default, explicitly revertible and flagged for human QA rather than gated): a rescued dot is up to ~15 minutes stale and sits at the driver's last SCAN, not the vehicle — and it stops advancing the moment they stop scanning even if still driving. So it should read as "last known", not as a live fix. updateDriverMarkers() (ScannerMap.vue:691-735) currently plots every entry uniformly and never reads provenance. Branch on position_source === 'scan_path': dim the icon and extend the marker title so hovering explains what the dot is. Note the existing marker-update branch only calls setPosition()/setIcon() and never setTitle(), so the title is stale after the first poll — it must now be updated too, otherwise a kit that transitions gps <-> scan_path keeps the wrong tooltip. Keep the change additive and provenance-tolerant: a missing position_source (driver PWA, older cached payload) must render exactly as today. Leave the deck.gl nameplate TextLayer (:1398-1421) and fitToDriverPositions() (:737-752) alone — a rescued dot still deserves a nameplate and still belongs in the bounds. No JS test runner in this repo, so the test_filter is t2's PHP payload-contract test as a proxy; real verification is human QA (this is the node most likely to be reverted on a look-at-this).

subtasks.title: Rebuild and commit front-end assets (after the Vue changes)
subtasks.approach: This repo TRACKS public/build (15 files incl. manifest.json), so a Vue change that is not accompanied by rebuilt, committed assets does not take effect for anyone — the org map would ship the server fix with the old bundle. This node MUST run after t3 and t4 land; it is deliberately parallelizable:false because `npm run build` mutates repo-root files OUTSIDE its target_files and must not race another worker. TRAP (known repo behaviour, memory: npm-build-regenerates-boost-docs): `npm run build` = `vite build && node scripts/version-sw.mjs && php artisan filament:assets`, and the Laravel Boost step regenerates CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / the copilot + junie instruction files and DROPS boost.json. Every one of those must be reverted so the commit contains ONLY real asset changes. Expect service-worker timestamp/hash churn from version-sw.mjs (memory: tailwindcss-v4 phantom-class note) — that churn is legitimate, the doc regeneration is not. No PHP test covers built assets: do NOT run the full suite for this node (it cannot finish locally under the 128M memory_limit — memory: platform-full-suite-memory-limit). The gate is the build exiting 0, the revert checklist, and a manifest diff that shows only the clarity-scout entrypoints moving.
subtasks.intended_diffs:
1. Confirm t3 + t4 are committed first (git log / git diff --stat on the two Vue files).

3. Revert the generated-doc collateral BEFORE staging:

     git checkout -- <copilot + junie instruction files, whatever `git status` shows>
     git checkout -- boost.json   # if it was dropped/modified
   Then re-run `git status --short` and confirm NOTHING outside public/build/** (plus any
   legitimately re-versioned service-worker file emitted by scripts/version-sw.mjs) is dirty.
4. Expected asset churn: content-hashed filenames rotate for the clarity-scout entrypoints

   affected, birdseye-_aeX2DcW.js) plus the matching public/build/manifest.json entries.
   Old hashed files are deleted and new ones added — `git add -A public/build` so the
   deletions are staged too, otherwise the tree carries orphans.
5. Sanity-read the manifest diff: entries for resources/js/clarity-scout/* should move; unrelated
   entrypoints (filament-map-widget, zone-manager, kit-user-path, theme) should NOT. If they do,
   it is Tailwind v4 phantom-class drift, not your change — say so rather than committing blind.
6. Commit only public/build/** in this node.

subtasks.title: Update the okf wiki for the new tier-2 fallback
subtasks.approach: The okf wiki is canonical domain knowledge per CLAUDE.md and today it explicitly documents the asymmetry this ticket removes: scout-clickhouse-queries.md:111-118 spells out kitPosition()'s 3-tier degrade while :75-91 presents OrgLivePositionsQuery as the whole story for the org dots, and scout-birds-eye.md:25 lists driver-positions as "Backed by: OrgLivePositionsQuery". Both go stale the moment t2 ships. Document the new query class, the tier ordering, the not-on-throw rule, the two different join keys, and the new position_source field; and record in one line that driverPaths()/OrgLivePathsQuery and the single-driver livePath() still carry the unfixed idiom (DEV-2228) so the next reader does not assume parity. While in scout-birds-eye.md, also correct the pre-existing staleness at :51-60: the orgScoutKits() pseudocode still shows a `$kits->filter(fn => $settings->has($kit->id))` enrollment gate that DEV-2182 removed — the real code (ClarityScoutBirdsEyeController.php:703-734) is Kit::forOrg()->excludingDeleted() with settings as an OPTIONAL relation, proven by the passing test test_drivers_lists_all_active_org_kits_regardless_of_scout_enrollment. Docs-only: no phpunit filter applies, so test_filter is null — the real gate is `php scripts/okf-lint.php` exiting 0 (broken links + resource: paths), which CI also runs on any okf/** change. Do NOT run the full PHP suite for this node.
